EngagementConfig.description:
How engagement is labelled: whether the animal is still attempting the task. Kept from Tom Childs'
model, whose gen_session.py printed an engaged success rate beside the stage; the stage rules
(stage.py) never used it, and nothing here reads it now.

A mouse partway through an experiment often keeps running but stops licking. Those trials are not failures (it
is not attempting the task), so they are labelled separately rather than scored as misses. Engagement is read
from whether each trial contained a lick, smoothed over a window of trials.

rollWindow.description: Trials averaged around each trial when deciding engagement. Prefer an odd value
rollWindow.title: RollWindow

rollThreshold.description: Lick fraction at or below which the animal counts as disengaged
rollThreshold.title: RollThreshold

minEpoch.description: Shortest run of trials that can be called engaged or disengaged; shorter runs are absorbed into their neighbours
minEpoch.title: MinEpoch

OptogeneticsConfig.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation: av-dome's OptogeneticsSettings field for field, and the laser started as
av-dome starts it (Pip, 9 Nov 2026), but lasting the whole trial.

The stimulation sites, laser power and ramp-down are set in the Zapit stimulus config loaded in Zapit, not
here. Bonsai reads the same file only to list its conditions (stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ...) and draws
one per stimulated trial. Each stimulated trial's StartStimulus carries the condition, stim_duration and
stim_delay; Zapit starts the laser stim_delay after the trial's start (beep 0: the trigger pulse, or the
command on a rig without hardware triggering). The workflow stops it at the trial's outcome, so it covers the
trial, as Tom Childs' did; stim_duration only caps it. Zapit's host, port and triggering are rig.yml's zapit block.

zapitConfigPath.title: ZapitConfigPath

stimProbability.title: StimProbability

stimDelay.title: StimDelay

stimDuration.description: Longest the stimulation lasts, in seconds: the laser is stopped at the trial's outcome, so it covers the trial, and this caps it if the outcome is late (av-dome: the stimulation duration)
stimDuration.title: StimDuration

excludeRepeats.description: Whether repeat trials are excluded from stimulation (av-dome's; this task has no repeat trials)
excludeRepeats.title: ExcludeRepeats

pseudorandomSelection.description: Draw conditions from a shuffled queue rather than independently
pseudorandomSelection.title: PseudorandomSelection

warmupTrials.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no stimulation
warmupTrials.title: WarmupTrials

TruncationConfig.description:
Truncated trials, used in stage 6 only.

On a truncated trial the cue (tone and grating) switches off part way along the sweep. Everything else about
the trial is unchanged, so it is still rewarded as normal: the animal has to keep going and find the reward
zone without the cue.

fraction.description: Fraction of stage 6 trials that are truncated, split evenly between the truncation points
fraction.title: Fraction

points.description: Where the cue switches off, as a fraction of the sweep on a log scale. The reward floor is at about 0.8
points.title: Points
